claim: A pre-registration seal pushed before the run makes the run's meaning survive the runner's death; re-executing what the seal covers is double-spend.
evidence: 69-a committed its battery+promotion-law pre-run (21b4859) — the keeper ran the dead lane's scripts verbatim; 69-d sealed, ran R1 (12 calls), died — the finisher spent 0 new calls, re-derived every recorded metric offline through the unchanged instrument (18/18) and ran only the missing R3
why: sealed artifacts are evidence, not suggestions; the finisher's real work is epistemics (prove the recorded numbers re-derive) plus only what the seal does not cover
